INDEPENDENT ROUTE WARNINGS · NMO 108974
Tac1Cre / Brainbow SP-class excitatory interneuron is an independent NeuroMorpho source record and is not the morphology of mouse.sc.vsx2_hoxa10, another SCI entity, a molecular cluster, or another reconstruction.
The 60 micrometre parasagittal section and source-reported Dendrites Complete integrity require slice-aware interpretation and cannot establish a complete whole-cell arbor.
The source reconstruction domain reports No Axon; this is missing reconstruction coverage, not evidence that the biological cell lacked an axon.
The SWC header states that 9 original soma contours were averaged into 9 standardized soma points; those points are not original contour vertices, a membrane, a nucleus, or a volumetric soma segmentation.
A deterministic radius-derived display surface is permitted from source-authorized radii, but it is not an observed membrane or measurement surface.
Identity wording is limited to source_metadata_cell_class_and_Tac1_IRES2_Cre_D_line; no direct individual-cell transcript, peptide-abundance, or cross-study molecular identity assay is claimed.
The route does not claim direct SP peptide or mRNA confirmation in this exact reconstructed cell; radial morphology is a source-cohort interpretation rather than this record's deposited annotation.
Missing same-specimen membrane, nucleus, organelle, synapse, receptor, and ultrastructure evidence renders zero internal primitives.
Source-local display scaling creates no atlas registration, laminar placement beyond source metadata, relationship to another route, or prevalence estimate.
